manifest_metadata.scope: native Python runtime and subregion validation driver
manifest_metadata.exclusion_reason: unrelated original-software reference sources; not used by segment_4_subregions

selection_rule: Fixed participant-ID order before any segmentation or Dice inspection; ses-test only

methods.design: Ten predetermined different subjects, one final FNIT all-structure result per mode; no within-method repeatability inference.
methods.cohorts: cohort_all includes ten planned subjects; cohort_new_subjects excludes development_seen and keeps nine planned subjects, including failures.
methods.raw: Published T1 as project input, without added project defacing; automatic FNIT preprocessing is part of measured raw pipeline.
methods.stage: This subject's complete official recon-all norm/aseg/wmparc; separate conditional accuracy from raw end-to-end.
methods.native: Raw uses original published T1 grid; stage uses its actual official norm input grid. Official labels mapped by nearest-neighbor.
methods.hr: One official HR axes/spacing/integer phase union grid covering official plus both FNIT modes; no fitted registration or phase.
methods.support: Only requested same-family atlas labels count; other labels are background. Official right hippo/amygdala nonzero IDs receive +10000 once.
methods.na: Both-empty hard labels have undefined Dice/Jaccard; one-sided absence has zero Dice/Jaccard. Soft relative difference is abs(a-b)/mean(a,b), undefined if both zero.
methods.failure: Every planned subject retains 440 rows. Missing/failed/invalid outputs carry NA with reasons, never zero scores or accuracy-based exclusion.
methods.aggregation: Macro subject distributions of each ROI and each case-family score; sample standard deviation ddof=1. Planned denominators, valid counts and NA counts are explicit.
methods.jacobian: Finite positive saved minimum of each fitted tetrahedral mesh. No voxelwise Jacobian image or unrecorded all-field finite assertion.
methods.timing: API compute/save/total and actual runner watcher process wall reported separately; official recon-all, each subregion command and recorded end-to-end times. No synthetic step Dice.

run_preparation_summary.scope: Archived environment/startup preparation; separate from FNIT algorithm outcomes.

figure_selection.rule: All completed raw-native subjects; median uses lower central case if even count; worst ROI sorts Dice ascending, official voxel count descending, label ID and case ID. No image appearance criterion.

cohort_all.interpretation: Subject-level distributions of accuracy/runtime, not repeated-run noise or confidence intervals. NA/failures are retained in planned denominators.
